items.title: Powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake kills at least 38 in Indonesia
items.description: A search and rescue operation is under way to find survivors in Flores, an island in eastern Indonesia.

items.title: 'I shot Mr Thompson'- What it was like inside court as Mangione pleaded guilty
items.description: It marked the first time a court had heard Mangione describe how he committed a crime that garnered worldwide attention.

items.title: BBC seeks to subpoena Trump's family members in Panorama lawsuit
items.description: The BBC's lawyers argue Trump's family members "have personal knowledge" of his intentions in the speech he gave outside the US Capitol on 6 January 2021.

items.title: US aircraft carrier on way to relieve USS Lincoln after issues reported aboard
items.description: Thousands of sailors on the Lincoln have reportedly faced food shortages and broken plumbing, with some considering jumping overboard.

items.title: South Korea proposes talks to officially end war with North
items.description: Lee Jae Myung offers chance to end the conflict, which has been frozen since an armistice in 1953.

items.title: France's top court blocks social media ban for under-15s
items.description: The Constitutional Council says it infringes upon freedom of expression - but President Macron vows to prepare a new draft.

items.title: Builders unearth €9m gold stash sealed in walls of Belgian property
items.description: Construction workers found the stash in the walls of a cellar while drilling to lay sewage pipes.
